name: Polarours
description: Animals that can survive even extreme cold, and that boast large bodies and thick fur. Despite their size, Polyarbears are actually quite agile, being able to leap between ice floes and pursue their prey without making a sound, making them the best hunters in the tundra. Skilled in combat, the Polyarbear is no tame beast, and will not submit to either beast or man easily. As such, they are regarded in some regions of Snezhnaya as a symbol of strength.
